variables.matins_canon: Canon of St. Cosmas on 6 with refrain 'Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee'
variables.katavasia: Heirmos of the Canon ('With severed rod the sea was parted')
variables.ode_9_zadostoinyk: Come, O faithful, let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the table of immortality in the upper room...
variables.exaposteilarion: Thy bridal chamber I see adorned, O my Savior, and I have no wedding garment that I may enter there. O Giver of Light, enlighten the vesture of my soul and save me.
variables.exaposteilarion_breakdown: twice; Glory, Both now: once more
variables.dismissal_troparion: When the glorious disciples were enlightened at the washing of the feet (without Theotokion).
variables.first_hour_prophecy: Troparion of Prophecy (Tone 3), 1st Prokeimenon (Tone 1: 'Let them know that the Lord is Thy Name'), Paremia (Jeremiah 11:18–12:5, 9–11, 14–15), 2nd Prokeimenon (Tone 8: 'Pray and give praise to the Lord our God')

vespers_stichera_distribution.glory: The Lamb, foretold by Isaiah, willingly comes to be slaughtered (Tone 2)
vespers_stichera_distribution.both_now: Truly, Judas is the son of those ungrateful (Tone 6)

variables.zadostoinyk: Come, O faithful, let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the table of immortality in the upper room...
variables.reserve_lamb_note: According to the Sluzhebnik and Synod of Lviv, the priest prepares and consecrates a second Lamb in the Melchizedek vessel, to be reserved in the tabernacle for the sick throughout the year.

variables.twelve_gospels_title: Matins of the Holy and Redeeming Passion of Our Lord (The Twelve Passion Gospels)
variables.royal_hours_full: Royal Hours (1st, 3rd, 6th, 9th) with full Old Testament Paremias, Epistles, and Gospels
variables.vespers_shroud_procession: Great Vespers with the Procession and Exposition of the Holy Shroud (Epitaphios / Plashchanytsia) and Troparia 'The noble Joseph' and 'The angel stood by the tomb'

variables.matins_canon: Canon of Holy Saturday on 12 with Heirmos ('He who buried beneath the wave of the sea')
variables.lamentations_title: Jerusalem Matins: The Lamentations (Encomia) at the Tomb of the Lord (Psalm 118 in Three Stases) with Great Doxology and Procession of the Shroud

vespers_stichera_distribution.glory: Tone VI: 'Today the dread tomb retains Him Who holds creation in His palm...'
vespers_stichera_distribution.both_now: Tone I: 'Let us praise the Virgin Mary, the glory of the world...'

variables.trisagion_replace: All you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia.
variables.alleluia_replace: Instead of Alleluia, we sing in Tone VII: 'Arise, O God, judge the earth' (during which the clergy change into bright white vestments).
variables.cherubic_hymn_replace: Let all mortal flesh keep silent, and stand with fear and trembling...
variables.zadostoinyk: Do not weep for Me, O Mother, beholding in the tomb the Son Whom you conceived in your womb without seed...
variables.koinonikon: The Lord awoke as from sleep, and has risen to save us. Alleluia.
variables.post_communion_replace: Instead of 'We have seen the true light', we proceed directly to the Thanksgiving Litany.
